what: Marketplace Pulse reports Etsy marketplace active buyers in Q4 2025 were 86.50 million, down approximately 3% year-over-year from 89.60 million.
verbatim_snippet: "Last reported quarter 2025 Q4 it was 86.50 million, down by -3% year-over-year from 89.60 million."
notes: Marketplace Pulse data tracking page based on Etsy SEC filings. Degraded from direct_verified to provisional due to uncertainty about whether the page was directly fetched or captured from search index. Figures consistent with Etsy's own Q4 2025 press release (F-15).
